scope: National reentry resource navigation for returning citizens, families, correctional staff, and community organizations

records.name: Federal Bureau of Prisons Community Reentry Network
records.description: Federal Bureau of Prisons electronic clearinghouse connecting returning citizens, incarcerated people preparing for release, families, staff, and the public with faith-based community organizations offering reentry support across the United States.
records.availability_notes: The Federal Bureau of Prisons described the network in September 2024 as a national public resource with more than 4,000 member organizations. The directory emphasizes faith-based organizations, and individual listings, services, eligibility, accessibility, religious expectations, geographic coverage, and contact information must be verified directly. The Salesforce-based public page produced intermittent loading and CSS errors during verification on August 6, 2026, so RDA should provide a fallback link to the BOP overview and never imply that every directory result is currently reachable or available.
